'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Gaza war hostage crisis]]
***[[Israeli-American]] hostage [[Edan Alexander]] is released by [[Hamas]] after being kept in captivity in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] for 19 months since the [[October 7 Hamas-led attack on Israel|October 7 attack]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israel-says-not-committed-hamas-ceasefire-only-safe-corridor-us-hostage-release-2025-05-12/ (Reuters)]
*[[Libyan crisis (2011–present)|Libyan crisis]]
**[[2025 Tripoli clashes]]
***Clashes erupt between rival militia gunmen from the 444th Brigade and the Stability Support Apparatus in [[Tripoli, Libya|Tripoli]], [[Libya]], after the [[assassination]] of Commander [[Abdel Ghani al-Kikli]]. Six people are injured, and a [[state of emergency]] is declared by authorities. [https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-853734 (''The Jerusalem Post'')] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/5/12/un-urges-calm-as-heavy-fire-clashes-erupt-in-libyas-tripoli (Al Jazeera English)]
*[[Kurdistan Workers' Party insurgency]]
**At its 12th Congress, the [[Kurdistan Workers' Party]] announces an [[Ceasefire|immediate halt]] to its [[insurgent]] activities in [[Turkey]] and plans for its formal dissolution. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/5/12/kurdish-pkk-to-disband-potentially-ending-decades-of-conflict-turkey (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/kurdish-pkk-dissolves-after-decades-struggle-with-turkey-news-agency-close-2025-05-12/ (Reuters)]
*[[Myanmar civil war (2021–present)|Myanmar civil war]]
**The [[National Unity Government of Myanmar|National Unity Government]] of [[Myanmar]] says that an [[airstrike]] by [[Tatmadaw|junta forces]] killed 17 students and injured 20 others at a school in [[Tabayin]], [[Sagaing Region]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/myanmar-opposition-says-junta-airstrike-kills-17-school-children-2025-05-12/ (Reuters)]
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**The remains of 30 people believed to have been killed by [[Islamic State]] militants are found in a search by [[Qatar]] and the U.S. [[Federal Bureau of Investigation]] in the remote town of [[Dabiq, Syria|Dabiq]], [[Aleppo Governorate]], [[Syria]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/remains-of-30-people-believed-killed-by-is-militants-found-in-syria-in-a-search-by-qatar-and-fbi/ (CTV News)]
*Unknown gunmen attack a [[China|Chinese]] [[artisanal mining|artisanal]] [[gold mine]] in [[Narena]], [[Koulikoro Region]], [[Mali]], killing one [[Malians|Malian]] and two others from [[Ghana]], and abducting two [[China|Chinese]] nationals. [https://apnews.com/article/mali-mining-jnim-jihadists-sahara-narena-chinese-559b12181b7a705c384a898b7d26b99c (AP)] 

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Thirteen people are killed by an expired ammunition explosion in [[Garut Regency]], [[West Java]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://jakartaglobe.id/news/garut-explosion-update-what-went-wrong-in-ammo-blast-that-killed-13 (''Jakarta Globe'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[China–United States trade war]]
**The U.S. and China agree to a [[trade deal]] in which, for 90 days, U.S. [[tariff]]s on most [[Economy of China|Chinese goods]] will drop from 145% to 30%, while China's retaliatory tariffs on U.S. goods will drop from 125% to 10%. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/czx0ry7kdk5o (BBC News)]
*[[Immigration policy of the second Donald Trump administration]], [[South Africa–United States relations]]
**The first group of [[Afrikaners]] arrive in the [[United States]] after [[President of the United States|U.S. president]] [[Donald Trump]] grants [[refugee]] status to the white minority group, who Trump says face a "genocide" in the [[South African farm attacks]]. The [[government of South Africa]] rejects the claims. [https://apnews.com/article/south-africa-us-refugees-trump-afrikaners-16e34760b93cfa66f15b4cd8380743c1 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Philippine general election]]
**[[Filipinos]] vote to elect all 317 members of the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] and 12 members of the [[Senate of the Philippines|Senate]], in addition to [[2025 Philippine local elections|local elections]]. [https://asianjournal.com/philippines/philippines-2025-midterm-elections-high-stakes-shifting-alliances-a-test-of-leadership/ (''Asian Journal'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/philippines-votes-high-stakes-midterms-amid-marcos-duterte-showdown-2025-05-11/ (Reuters)]
